lake_area_method: spherical polygon area, subtract holes; whole waterbody before frame clipping
source_water_display: same filtered water mask in all three images; original reference retained
ocean_mask_method: Natural Earth ocean polygon clipped to reference frame; no DEM-negative pit or river-line inference; remove narrow channels with morphological opening radius 3 cells
lake_sources: existing Natural Earth / OSM polygons plus matching OSM reservoir polygons
